description: This file defines a set of classes and functions related to rendering and customizing Markdown content within an Android application. It includes options for handling table rendering and a function to apply Markdown to a TextView with custom options.

classes.name: MarkdownOptions
classes.description: A configuration class for customizing Markdown rendering, allowing setting maximum table columns and a custom replacement node for large tables.

classes.name: OptionsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for traversing Markdown nodes to identify large tables and replace them if necessary.

classes.name: TableRowVisitor
classes.description: A helper visitor class for counting table cells within a table row.

methods.name: applyTo
methods.description: An inline extension function for Markwon to apply Markdown rendering to a TextView with customizable options.
